required_patterns.prefix-v1: New endpoints should follow the /api/v1 prefix where appropriate.

architectural_constraints.middleware-order: Authentication middleware must precede authorization middleware.

required_patterns.quizio-envelope: All responses must return { msg, data, type, code }.
required_patterns.status-codes: 200 for success, 201 for creation, 400/401/403/404/500 for errors.

architectural_constraints.thin-handlers: Handlers should only handle req/res and delegate logic to services.
architectural_constraints.response-sanitization: Always sanitize output by removing internal fields (password, createdAt, updatedAt, refreshToken).

required_patterns.singleton-class: Services should be implemented as static classes or exported functions.
required_patterns.error-throwing: Services should throw meaningful AppError (with message, status, and code) that handlers can catch.
required_patterns.strict-string-matching: Always use .trim().toLowerCase() when comparing input options (fabric, style) with database values.
required_patterns.lean-queries: Use .lean() for all Mongoose read operations to ensure plain objects and better performance.

architectural_constraints.domain-isolation: Services should focus on a single domain (e.g., AuthService, ProductService).
architectural_constraints.dual-database-orchestration: When fetching related context from Mongoose (catalog), perform strict data extraction and pass into a single Prisma $transaction block for cross-system atomicity.
architectural_constraints.resilient-fallback: Implement 'Standard' or 'Original' fallbacks for product options to prevent breaking orders when catalog configurations are missing modifiers.

required_patterns.idempotency: Webhook handlers MUST enforce idempotency by using a unique reference ID.
required_patterns.transaction-recheck: Always re-query payment status inside a transaction before updating to prevent race conditions.
required_patterns.payment-intent: Expose a dedicated POST /:orderId/payment-intent endpoint that initializes a Paystack transaction and returns the accessCode for the frontend PaystackPop modal.
required_patterns.user-verify: Expose POST /verify/:reference for frontend-initiated verification after redirect/callback.

architectural_constraints.transaction-isolation: Verify external provider (Paystack) statuses independently before modifying the local order and payment database statuses.
architectural_constraints.webhook-signature: Always verify the x-paystack-signature header using the Paystack secret before processing webhook payloads. Reject unsigned webhooks with 401.
architectural_constraints.status-guard: Never create a payment intent for an order that is not in PENDING status.

required_patterns.prisma: Use Prisma for user, auth, and relational data.
required_patterns.mongoose: Use Mongoose for product catalog and document-based data.
required_patterns.order-snapshotting: Save snapshots of product options and price modifiers in the relational Order model.
required_patterns.pagination: Use mongoose-paginate-v2 for all paginated catalog queries.

architectural_constraints.external-packages: Database logic must be imported from @jhaz-imprints/db or @jhaz-imprints/catalog-db.

required_patterns.bullmq: Use BullMQ for asynchronous jobs like notifications.
required_patterns.dual-email: For 'order-confirmed' jobs, ALWAYS send two emails: one to the customer (confirmation) and one to the admin/tailor (production alert with full measurements). Each email send is independently wrapped in try/catch — failure of one must not block the other.
required_patterns.safe-defaults: All job data fields must have safe defaults (e.g., `productName || 'Custom Outfit'`, `totalPrice ?? 0`) to prevent crashes on partial data.
required_patterns.retry-policy: Configure queues with exponential backoff: { attempts: 3, backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 2000 } }.

architectural_constraints.worker-isolation: Workers should be defined in src/queues/ and started in app.ts.
architectural_constraints.non-blocking: Notification failures (emails, SMS) must never cause the main request to fail. Always enqueue and catch queue errors separately.

required_patterns.zod: Use Zod schemas from @jhaz-imprints/shared for all request validation.

architectural_constraints.strict-parsing: Use schema.parse(req.body) to ensure type safety.
